mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, robust supply chain conditions support sustained corporate output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1000 thousand units in a month signals residential construction contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL year-over-year > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 110.0 in a month signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 110.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
